messages.contextHelp.group.flight: Recording and science: what is happening?
messages.contextHelp.guide: Read the bundled collaboration guide (opens a new tab)
messages.contextHelp.recording.title: Recording is separate from science collection
messages.contextHelp.recording.body: Recording saves the flight. Science collection saves supported instrument acquisitions in a scientific session. Armed means waiting for a trigger; paused means collection is paused. Check the confirmed science status, source and retained observations. A button click or moving aircraft does not establish collection.
messages.contextHelp.quality.title: Scientific quality and missing observations
messages.contextHelp.quality.body: An operating instrument may still have unavailable, rejected or unassessed readings. Inspect readiness, source availability, calibration and quality warnings. Invalid or missing observations cannot become valid measurements by repeating an action.
messages.contextHelp.assignments.title: Assignments and test cards
messages.contextHelp.assignments.body: A campaign is a shared research objective. Claim or accept its published card, review the exact issued revision, then prepare a mission. Focus selects what you inspect; activation, attempts, evaluation and completion remain separate actions. A newer published revision does not replace your issued requirements.
messages.contextHelp.evaluation.title: Local evaluation and organization approval
messages.contextHelp.evaluation.body: A local pass describes your original retained evidence under the issued card. It is not organization approval. The organization independently reviews received evidence and decides contributions and campaign progress. Keep original results and review findings separate.
messages.contextHelp.roles.title: Roles and separate permissions
messages.contextHelp.roles.body: Administrators manage the organization; managers manage programs; reviewers need the permitted campaign review access; pilots contribute research. Your browser-approved desktop access may be read-only. Claiming, submitting and live sharing require their own grants. The server checks membership, expiry, identity and permission for every protected action.
messages.contextHelp.originals.title: Original observations and derived products
messages.contextHelp.originals.body: Original in-flight observations retain their flight, session, timestamps and hashes. A derived product is computed from retained inputs. It is not another acquisition and cannot increase original counts, grades or card credit. P06 can attach explicitly selected metadata/hash references for supported products; numerical terrain cells and point records are not included.
messages.contextHelp.corridor.title: Modeled corridor is not measured terrain
messages.contextHelp.corridor.body: The scanner corridor predicts a footprint from retained flight and configuration data. It is planning/model geometry, not measured terrain or proof of valid scientific coverage. Flight tracks and predicted overlap do not fill acquisition or source-data gaps.
messages.contextHelp.terrain.title: DEM and DSM
messages.contextHelp.terrain.body: A DEM describes a source-defined terrain elevation surface; a DSM describes a source-defined surface that can include vegetation or structures. The actual source declaration, units, date and vertical datum determine what heights mean. A displayed grid is not evidence that the simulated aircraft measured it.
messages.contextHelp.lidar.title: Historical LiDAR points
messages.contextHelp.lidar.body: These are genuine points from a historical source project when its original files and processing are verified. They were not measured by the MSFS aircraft. Preserve classification, original hashes, source/project, date, coordinate system, height reference, algorithm and limitations. Indexed COPC and unvalidated coordinate/vertical transforms remain unsupported.
messages.contextHelp.dates.title: Source date and simulated flight date
messages.contextHelp.dates.body: The historical acquisition date belongs to the source. Flight time, download/import time and processing time describe different events. An unknown source date stays unknown; the simulator date cannot replace it.
messages.contextHelp.datum.title: Vertical datum and unknown heights
messages.contextHelp.datum.body: A vertical datum defines the reference for height. Equal height units do not make different or unknown datums compatible. Unknown height references stay unknown. Do not compare them as verified aircraft clearance or convert between datums without a validated transform.
messages.contextHelp.coverage.title: Missing scientific coverage
messages.contextHelp.coverage.body: A source boundary shows availability, not valid observations everywhere inside it. NoData cells, excluded sources, missed acquisitions and unsupported areas remain gaps. A corridor, map or live position cannot supply missing science.
messages.contextHelp.provenance.title: Provenance and verification
messages.contextHelp.provenance.body: Provenance identifies the original source, hashes, processing algorithm and evidence associations. Verified bytes do not by themselves establish scientific suitability or approval. A recipient can verify the received package; a source hash alone cannot prove an unshared original file.
messages.contextHelp.downloads.title: Downloads, storage and deletion
messages.contextHelp.downloads.body: Opening help, a map or an organization does not authorize scientific downloads. Review source permissions, actual storage and limitations in the Scientific Library. Original source-owned deletion also removes dependent products under the existing safeguards. An already expressly received organization copy cannot be recalled by deleting your local copy.
messages.contextHelp.submission.title: Exact recipient and explicit submission
messages.contextHelp.submission.body: Review the exact organization/server, campaign and issued revision, selected original evidence, optional supporting references, size or unknown-size notice, privacy disclosure and Submit Evidence permission. Saving a draft does not authorize transmission. Approval, queued/sending, server receipt and scientific review are distinct. Retry only through the existing delivery controls.
messages.contextHelp.privacy.title: Live sharing is an independent choice
messages.contextHelp.privacy.body: Connecting, claiming, recording, collecting and submitting do not start sharing. Explicitly opted-in current flights are visible to permitted active organization members until consent ends. Shared stale positions clear; no shared track or replay is stored. Stop Sharing leaves personal research and recording intact. External Discord announcements require a further independent authorization.

messages.help.quickStart.title: Your first research flight
messages.help.quickStart.connect: Open the companion and connect MSFS. Check the actual connection and freshness indicators before relying on aircraft telemetry.
messages.help.quickStart.prepare: In Missions, choose an experiment and review its aircraft, instrument and source requirements. Fly Now prepares and selects a plan; it does not record a flight or collect science.
messages.help.quickStart.record: Use Start Recording explicitly in Current Flight. Recording preserves the flight record; its active indicator alone does not mean scientific collection has started.
messages.help.quickStart.collect: Review readiness, then explicitly start scientific collection or arm an automatic trigger. Armed means waiting, not collecting. Trust confirmed collection state and retained observations, not an optimistic button click.
messages.help.quickStart.pause: Pausing science leaves flight recording running. Resume science when permitted, and end a scientific session or the flight using its separate explicit control.
messages.help.quickStart.results: In Results, inspect Overview, Explore and Evidence. Original observations, modeled corridors, genuine DEM/DSM products and historical LiDAR returns remain different evidence. Missing coverage and unknown dates or height references remain unknown.
messages.help.quickStart.sources: Use Scientific Library to review exact sources, download permissions, storage and dependencies. Downloading needs its existing authorization. Read the exact permanent-deletion preview before approving it; language selection never authorizes either action.
messages.help.quickStart.organizations: An organization connection or assignment claim does not share your flight or upload evidence. Review the exact recipient and package, then authorize submission separately. Local evaluation is not server approval; live-location sharing requires separate consent.
messages.help.referenceEnglish: The detailed scientific reference below is in English. Guided steps and contextual explanations use your selected candidate language.
